results.title: Surrogate design differs from requested options
results.reason: README introduces a surrogate type in Project B, not any of the issue's three options, and explicitly lists unions as unsupported.

results.title: Immutable types silently serialize nothing
results.reason: Get-only members are dropped and no zero-member diagnostic exists. But init-only setters pass the filter, and classes without a parameterless ctor (positional records) get an error. README documents the skip.

results.title: No duplicate check for the same data type
results.reason: No duplicate diagnostic exists, but both are not added: ObjectInfos is a sorted set keyed by DataType, so the second one is silently dropped and the partial class may get no body.

results.title: Wrong args passed to existing diagnostics
results.reason: NoDeserializingConstructor's message has no placeholders and gets none. MemberNeedsKey expects {0}.{1} and gets type name and member name, the same as TypeCollector does.

results.title: Symbols cached in incremental pipeline, collected twice
results.reason: Collect does run twice and the request record holds symbols. But the existing pipelines already pass ITypeSymbols and combine with CompilationProvider, so this follows the established pattern.

results.title: Untested rejection paths
results.reason: Tests cover MsgPack019/020/022, the abstract case of 021 and mixed keys only. No tests cover generic/inaccessible types, the missing constructor, or init-only/required members.
